quotes.quote: checkout.md ("Repeating Types"): "All types except `subtotal` and `total` MAY appear multiple times — for example, multi-jurisdiction tax lines or itemized fees", and "the `type` field is an open string".

A server with two tax lines, itemized fees, or a custom entry (e.g. `duty`, `account_credit`) fails "Total math mismatch" even when its totals are correct — including checkout.md's own Split-tax and account_credit examples.

Use the spec's own Verification formula (checkout.md): `sum(e.amount for e in totals if e.type != "total") == total_entry.amount` — a signed sum over all non-`total` entries (amounts are signed; discounts are negative, so no special-casing).

all types except ``subtotal``/``total`` MAY repeat (checkout.md "Repeating Types" — e.g. multi-jurisdiction tax lines or itemized fees) and ``type`` is an open string, so picking one entry per well-known type would both reject conformant servers and miss servers whose total drops a repeated or custom entry.
